title: Design System: Dr. Adel Yousry Dental Clinic

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive booking or contact action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:0 26px; background:var(--red); color:var(--text); border:1px solid var(--red); font-weight:800; font-size:14px; text-decoration:none; transition:background .2s ease,color .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:transparent; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cyan-soft); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Quiet Link
components.css: .ds-quiet-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:48px; padding-bottom:2px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-strong); color:var(--muted); font-size:14px; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; transition:color .2s ease,border-color .2s ease; } .ds-quiet-link:hover { color:var(--cyan-soft); border-color:var(--cyan); } .ds-quiet-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cyan-soft); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: V3 Anchor Navigation
components.description: In-page section navigation for the single-page V3 route.
components.css: .ds-anchor-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; min-height:50px; padding:0 var(--gutter); background:rgba(6,8,9,.94); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); } .ds-anchor-mark { padding-inline-end:16px; border-inline-end:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--cyan-soft); font:400 12px/1 Anton,Impact,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.2em; } .ds-anchor-nav a { color:var(--muted); font-size:13px; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; } .ds-anchor-nav a:hover { color:var(--cyan-soft); }

components.name: Case Figure
components.description: A real before/after image with an Arabic title and Latin tag.
components.css: .ds-case-figure { margin:0; min-width:0; } .ds-case-figure.ds-case-wide { grid-column:span 7; } .ds-case-figure.ds-case-tall { grid-column:span 5; } .ds-case-media { position:relative; aspect-ratio:4/3; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--card); } .ds-case-figure figcaption { display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; padding-top:12px; font-size:13px; } .ds-case-figure figcaption span { color:var(--cyan-soft); font:400 10px/1 Anton,Impact,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.12em; }

components.name: Review Block
components.description: Featured patient quote with source metadata.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-review-block { display:flex; flex-direction:column; border-top:2px solid var(--red); padding-top:26px; } .ds-review-source { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; color:var(--cyan-soft); font:400 11px/1 Anton,Impact,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.14em; } .ds-review-block blockquote { margin:28px 0 30px; font-size:clamp(22px,2.8vw,34px); font-weight:700; line-height:1.65; } .ds-review-block footer { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; padding-top:18px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); font-size:13px; } .ds-review-block footer a { margin-inline-start:auto; color:var(--cyan-soft); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(154,217,229,.35); }

components.name: V3 Readout Cell
components.description: A verified metric rendered as a technical readout.
components.css: .ds-v3-readout { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; padding:15px 18px 14px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); text-decoration:none; } .ds-v3-readout b { font:400 25px/1.1 Anton,Impact,sans-serif; } .ds-v3-readout span { color:var(--cyan-soft); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; } .ds-v3-readout small { color:var(--muted); font-size:11px; } .ds-v3-readout:hover { border-color:rgba(45,167,196,.46); }

components.name: V3 Treatment Map Tile
components.description: A numbered specialty tile in the diagnostic treatment map.
components.html:
01

تركيبات الفك الكامل

إعادة بناء الفك الكامل.

FULL ARCH
components.css: .ds-v3-map-tile { display:flex; flex-direction:column; min-height:214px; padding:24px 22px 20px; background:var(--ink); } .ds-v3-map-tile > span:first-child { color:var(--cyan-soft); font:400 13px/1 Anton,Impact,sans-serif; } .ds-v3-map-tile h3 { margin:14px 0 8px; font-size:18px; } .ds-v3-map-tile p { margin:0 0 22px; color:var(--muted); font-size:13px; } .ds-v3-map-tile > span:last-child { margin-top:auto; color:var(--muted); font:400 10px/1.4 Anton,Impact,sans-serif; } .ds-v3-map-tile:hover { background:var(--card); }

components.name: V3 Case Plate
components.description: An approved case image with a cyan reticle and Latin plate tag.
components.css: .ds-v3-plate { margin:0; grid-column:span 3; } .ds-v3-plate.ds-v3-wide { grid-column:span 6; } .ds-v3-plate-media { position:relative; aspect-ratio:4/3; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--card); } .ds-v3-plate-tag { position:absolute; top:10px; left:10px; padding:5px 8px; background:rgba(6,8,9,.78); color:var(--cyan-soft); font:400 10px/1 Anton,Impact,sans-serif; } .ds-v3-plate figcaption { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; padding-top:11px; font-size:13px; }

components.name: V3 Patient Note
components.description: A verified review presented as a ruled patient note.
components.css: .ds-v3-note { padding:24px; border:1px solid var(--line); background-color:var(--card); background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0 31px, rgba(255,255,255,.035) 31px 32px); } .ds-v3-note > div { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; color:var(--cyan-soft); font:400 11px/1 Anton,Impact,sans-serif; } .ds-v3-note blockquote { margin:20px 0; font-size:16px; line-height:1.85; } .ds-v3-note footer { display:flex; gap:16px; padding-top:14px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); font-size:12px; } .ds-v3-note footer a { margin-inline-start:auto; color:var(--cyan-soft); }

components.name: V3 Approval Stamp
components.description: Decorative approval mark in the red closing band.
components.css: .ds-v3-stamp { position:absolute; top:26px; right:var(--gutter); padding:8px 12px; transform:rotate(-4deg); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6); color:var(--text); font:400 11px/1.5 Anton,Impact,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.16em; } @media (max-width:700px){ .ds-v3-stamp { display:none; } }

narrative.overview: V3 is a diagnostic drafting grid: readouts, map tiles, case plates, a plotted protocol, and an approval band. Near-black ground, hairline rules, red decisions, and cyan measurement lines carry the system. The site is Arabic-first and RTL, pairing oversized Cairo display with Anton labels and Pinyon Script for the doctor's signature.
keyCharacteristics: Diagnostic drafting-grid rhythm: readouts, map tiles, case plates, and a plotted protocol.
V3 first viewport: premise physically left, scan-framed portrait physically right, readouts pinned below.
Asymmetric compositions that collapse cleanly to one column on mobile.
Proof integrated into the page edge or grid, not floating as a card row.
Hard edges, hairline borders, no rounded cards.

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Red owns the action and the headline turn. It never becomes a background for ordinary content except the closing call band.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section headings stand alone. Latin labels sit beside them, never above them.

rules.name: The Blueprint Grid Rule
rules.body: Cyan grid lines and reticles in V3 are measurement language, not decoration or a card scaffold.

rules.name: The Surface Distinction Rule
rules.body: V1 is the multi-page clinic site; V3 is the diagnostic treatment plan. Borrow facts, not composition.

dos: Do use real patient images from SOURCES.md with consent disclaimers.
Do keep Arabic as the reading order and use dir="ltr" only for Latin labels, numbers, and phone strings.
Do let section headings carry their own weight with no label above them.
Do keep external source links target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer".
Do keep V1's multi-page structure and V3's diagnostic blueprint as distinct systems.
donts: Don't add same-size icon cards, gradient text, glass decoration, or hard offset shadows.
Don't turn a rating or fee into a hero-metric card template.
Don't invent opening hours, Facebook statistics, or absolute “painless” claims.
Don't modify V1 routes while working on V3.
Don't make V3 a restyled copy of V1; its grid, readouts, and protocol must carry the difference.
